makemeahanzi.definition: extreme, top; final, furthest, utmost; pole

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 极 originally named the ridgepole, the highest beam of a roof, extended to 'extreme, utmost.'
及 (jí) gives the sound — 极 is also pronounced jí, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: orchid; elegant, graceful

characterDeckComponents.note: A stylized drawing of orchid blossoms and leaves growing up from the ground.

makemeahanzi.definition: to make noise, to make sound; sound

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 响 relates to sound, something that can be heard
向 (xiàng) gives a loose sound connection to 响's reading xiǎng

makemeahanzi.definition: building, house, shelter; room

etymology.hint: To stop 至 under a roof 尸 (variant of 厂)

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸, here a variant of 厂, depicts a roof or shelter.
至 depicts arriving or coming to rest — settling under a roof gave 屋 its meaning 'house, room.'

makemeahanzi.definition: province; frugal; to save, to leave out

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 省 originally involved careful looking or examining
少 (shǎo) gives a sound close to 省's reading shěng, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: top, summit, peak; to carry on the head

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 顶 names the top of the head, the crown.
丁 (dīng) gives the sound — an exact match with 顶.

makemeahanzi.definition: to bewitch, to charm; a fan of; infatuated

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 迷 originally described losing one's way while walking, extending to 'confused, obsessed.'
米 (mǐ) gives a sound distantly related to mí, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: stupid, foolish, dull, awkward

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 笨 originally related to the plain, unworked core of bamboo, later extending to mean dull or clumsy.
本 (běn) gives a sound close to bèn, sharing the same rhyme with a shifted tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: tower, spire, tall building

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 塔 refers to a tall earthen or stone structure.
荅 (dá) gives a sound distantly related to tǎ, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to disperse, to let go, to relax

etymology.hint: To scatter 散 seeds by hand 扌; 散 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 撒 describes scattering something by hand.
散 (to scatter, to disperse) — combined with the hand 扌, it gave 撒 its meaning 'to scatter, to release.'

makemeahanzi.definition: smoke, soot; opium; tobacco, cigarettes

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — smoke, 烟's meaning, rises from fire.
因 (yīn) gives a rhyme close to yān, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to shout, to yell, to call out; to howl; to cry

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 喊 describes an action made with the mouth, shouting.
咸 (xián) gives a sound distantly related to hǎn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: individual; each, every; all

etymology.hint: Walking 夂 and talking 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 夂 (a foot, to walk) — 各 pictures people arriving from different directions.
口 (mouth) — different people speaking gave 各 its meaning 'each' or 'every,' emphasizing individual distinctness.

makemeahanzi.definition: demon, evil spirit; magic, spell

characterDeckComponents.note: 鬼 (ghost) — 魔 names a demon or evil spirit.
麻 (má) gives a sound distantly related to mó, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: poison, venom; drug, narcotic

characterDeckComponents.note: 龶 depicts a poisonous plant, tying 毒 to its meaning 'poison.'
母 (mǔ) gives a rhyme close to dú, with the initial shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: weed, goosefoot; fallow field; used in transliterations

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass) — 莱 names a weedy plant, goosefoot.
来 (lái) is an exact match for the sound of 莱.

makemeahanzi.definition: to fall, to stumble, to trip

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 摔 involves a hand-related action of throwing down or a body falling.
率 (shuài) gives a sound close to shuāi, sharing the same initial and a similar rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to cut, to sever; to break off, to terminate

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 绝 originally meant to sever a thread completely, extended to mean 'to cut off, absolute'
色 (sè) gives a loose sound connection to 绝's reading jué

meanings: (of a responsibility) to be taken care of by

makemeahanzi.definition: to return, to go back; to return to, to revert

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 歸; a wife 帚 returning home; 追 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 彐 here depicts a broom, standing in for 帚 in the traditional form 歸 — the image of a wife returning home with her broom gave 归 its meaning 'to return.'

makemeahanzi.definition: fist; various forms of boxing

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — a fist is a closed hand.
Gives a sound distantly related to quán, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: used in 菩薩|菩萨[pu2 sa4]

makemeahanzi.definition: Buddhist diety; used in transliterations
foundation, base

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 基 relates to the ground or foundation something is built on.
其 (qí) gives a hint of the sound — 基 is pronounced jī, a connection that has shifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: bolt of cloth; mate, one of a pair; measure word for horses

characterDeckComponents.note: 匹 pictures a roll of cloth folded over itself — the image behind its meaning 'bolt of cloth,' later extended to a classifier for horses.

meanings: unit of money equal to 0.1 yuan, or 10 cents

makemeahanzi.definition: angle, corner; horn, horn-shaped

etymology.hint: A rhinoceros or other animal horn

characterDeckComponents.note: A drawing of a ridged, pointed animal horn.

makemeahanzi.definition: print; mark; seal, stamp

etymology.hint: A hand 爪 stamping a seal 卩

characterDeckComponents.note: 爪 (a hand/claw) — pressing down.
卩 depicts a seal or stamp — a hand pressing a seal down gave 印 its meaning 'to print, seal, stamp.'

meanings: host (i.e. sitting on east side of guest)

makemeahanzi.definition: east, eastern, eastward

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 東, the sun 日 rising behind a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 东 (simplified from 東) originally pictured the sun 日 rising behind a tree 木 — since the sun rises in the east, the character came to mean 'east.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to build, to construct, to invent, to manufacture

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 造's meaning 'to make, build,' an action carried through to completion.
告 (gào) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from zào.

makemeahanzi.definition: city, town; market, fair; to trade

meanings: vitamin (abbr. for 維生素|维生素[wei2 sheng1 su4])

makemeahanzi.definition: to preserve, to maintain, to hold together

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread/silk) — 维 relates to a connecting thread or fiber, extended to mean 'to maintain, to link'
隹 (zhuī) gives a loose sound connection to 维's reading wéi

makemeahanzi.definition: ailment, disease, illness

characterDeckComponents.note: 疒 (sickness) — 症 names a symptom or disease.
正 (zhèng) is an exact match for the sound of 症.

makemeahanzi.definition: root cause; the stem of a fruit; the peduncle of a flower

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 蒂 names the stem that attaches a fruit or flower to its plant.
帝 (dì) gives the sound — an exact match with 蒂.

makemeahanzi.definition: what? why? how?

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 怎's meaning 'how' relates to a mental inquiry, what's on one's mind.
乍 (zhà) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from zěn.

makemeahanzi.definition: era, generation; to substitute for, to replace

etymology.hint: A man 亻 caught 弋 by the passing of time

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 代 relates to a person's place in time.
弋 (a stake used to mark or catch something) — combined with 亻 (person), 代 came to mean a 'generation' or 'era,' and 'to take the place of' someone.

meanings: to press down with the foot

makemeahanzi.definition: to rise, to mount, to board, to climb

characterDeckComponents.note: 癶 (two feet) — 登 relates to climbing or ascending with one's legs
豆 (dòu) gives a sound distantly related to 登's reading dēng, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to lean on; to rely on

etymology.hint: Leaning on (trusting) 任 a table 几

characterDeckComponents.note: 任 (to trust, to bear) — 凭 describes trusting or relying on something.
几 (a small table) — leaning on a table for support pictures what it feels like to depend on something, giving 凭 its meaning 'to rely on.'

makemeahanzi.definition: rain

etymology.hint: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 is a simplified picture of raindrops falling from a cloud.

meanings: (printing) point (unit used to measure the size of type)

makemeahanzi.definition: pound; to weigh

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — historically, weights were made of or measured against stone.
旁 (páng) gives a sound related to 磅's reading bàng, sharing the final while the initial has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: final particle

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 咯 marks a sound made with the mouth, whether a cough or a spoken particle.
各 (gè) gives a sound close to gē, the same syllable with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rob, to snatch, to take by force

etymology.hint: A man 大 grasping something 寸

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (a person, arms spread wide) — depicts someone in the act of grabbing.
寸 (a hand) — grasping at something, together giving 夺 its meaning 'to seize, take by force.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to rent, to lease; tax, rent

etymology.hint: Regularly paid 且 tribute in grain 禾

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — 租 originally described tribute paid in grain.
且 here marks the payment as regular and ongoing — combined with the grain 禾, it gave 租 its meaning 'rent, tax.'

makemeahanzi.definition: hero; heroic, outstanding
elder; mature

etymology.hint: An old 老 person 亻; 老 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) marks this as referring to a person.
老 means 'old' and is pronounced lǎo — identical to 佬 — originally suggesting a mature man, now used more generally (often informally, or in Cantonese) for 'man, guy.'

meanings: bound set of bamboo slips used for record keeping
classifier for written items: chapter, article

makemeahanzi.definition: chapter, section; article, essay

etymology.hint: A bamboo ⺮ tablet 扁; 扁 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) recalls the bamboo strips ancient texts were written on, tying 篇 to writing.
扁 pictures something flat and thin, like a bamboo tablet — fitting for a single sheet or chapter of writing.

makemeahanzi.definition: section, department; field, branch; science

etymology.hint: A hand measuring 斗 grain 禾

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain, a rice/wheat plant) — 科 relates to sorting and measuring crops.
斗 (a measuring ladle) — measuring grain into ordered categories gave 科 its meaning 'a branch of study' or 'a department.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to hum; to sing softly; to moan, to groan

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — humming and groaning are vocal actions.
亨 (hēng) gives the sound — an exact match for 哼.

meanings: variant of 念[nian4], to read aloud

makemeahanzi.definition: to think of, to recall; to study

etymology.hint: To keep the present 今 in mind 心

characterDeckComponents.note: 今 (now, the present) — represents what is currently on one's mind.
心 (heart/mind) — keeping the present moment in mind gave 念 its meaning 'to think of, to read aloud, to study.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to tie, to fasten, to bind

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 绑 relates to tying something with thread or rope.
邦 (bāng) gives a sound close to bǎng, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to defend, to guard, to protect; to conserve; to wait

etymology.hint: Keeping something 寸 within one's walls 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (walls/roof) — the boundary of a home to be protected
寸 (a hand) — keeping watch, holding the space within the walls

makemeahanzi.definition: to promise; to approve, to assent to

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 诺 relates to a spoken promise or agreement.
若 (ruò) gives a rhyme close to nuò, sharing a related initial.

meanings: (bound form) circle(s) (i.e. specific group of people)

makemeahanzi.definition: forest, grove; surname

etymology.hint: Two trees 木 representing a forest

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree), doubled — two trees side by side depict a cluster of trees, the source of 林's meaning 'forest, grove.'
